name: Date

low.description: 2 small dates or 1 large Medjool date

moderate.description: 4 small dates or 2 large Medjool dates

high.description: 6 small dates or 3 large Medjool dates

siboNotes: Dates are concentrated in natural sugars and may feed bacterial overgrowth. Start with very small portions and monitor symptoms carefully.
preparationTips: Chop and use as a natural sweetener in small amounts
Soak dried dates in warm water to soften before blending
Store in airtight container in refrigerator for longer freshness
nutritionalHighlights: Natural source of energy from natural sugars
